title: Content-bound append-only proof authority and positive-baseline computation profile
rationale: Correct self-attesting authority, mutability, exact-match, replay-vacuity, migration, and canonical-version defects while integrating new bijective and positive-baseline work.
compatibility_impact: V1 records remain replay-readable but cannot authorize new theorem promotion; new writes use v2 generations.
replay_impact: Legacy records retain identity; v2 replay pass is non-vacuous.
security_impact: Authority outputs become server-produced, signed, immutable, and scope-protected.
migration_plan: Apply the additive Draft 5.3.1 SQL migration and reverify legacy proof bytes; never reinterpret v1 authority as v2.
